quotes.text: Grant and receive scoped payment credentials for agent-initiated purchases.
This article has multiple variants. Fetch one of the following URLs to view specific content for your use case:

old_evidence.text: Shared payment tokens (SPTs) are available to agents, customers, and sellers in the US.

An SPT is a scoped grant to use the customer’s payment method. The agent grants SPTs to your [Stripe profile](https://docs.stripe.com/get-started/account/profile.md), each with usage and expiration limits.
After you receive a granted `SharedPaymentToken`, create a `PaymentIntent` to complete the payment.
After the customer completes the required action, Stripe sends the `shared_payment.issued_token.active` webhook unless you deactivated the `SharedPaymentToken` in the meantime.
